_comment_top: Example .claude/standup.json. Place this at <project-root>/.claude/standup.json. Each datasource entry must define 'name', 'description', and exactly one of ('tool' + 'params') or 'command'.

datasources._comment: Jira via the Atlassian MCP. Used when issues are tracked in Jira.
datasources.name: qa-bugs
datasources.description: Open QA bug reports in Jira

params.jql: project = MYAPP AND status in ('To Do','In Progress') AND priority in (High, Highest)

datasources._comment: PM-defined feature stories tagged for the current quarter.
datasources.name: pm-features
datasources.description: PM-defined feature stories tagged for this quarter

params.jql: project = MYAPP AND issuetype = Story AND labels = 'this-quarter' AND statusCategory != Done

datasources._comment: Sentry via sentry-cli. Shell command form. JSON output is preferred.
datasources.name: prod-errors
datasources.description: Sentry unresolved errors with >10 occurrences in last 24h
datasources.command: sentry-cli issues list --org my-org --project my-project --query 'is:unresolved age:-24h timesSeen:>10' --json

datasources._comment: CloudWatch alarms via aws-cli. Shell command form.
datasources.name: prod-alarms
datasources.command: aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --state-value ALARM --region us-east-1 --alarm-name-prefix prod- --output json

datasources._comment: Grafana via curl. Shell command form. Requires GRAFANA_TOKEN and GRAFANA_URL env vars.
datasources.name: grafana-firing
